title: Late-Fee Floor for Small Monthly Payments — Fee Schedule Note
content:
The late-fee floor of Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts is the amount a late fee, once rounded to the cent, is raised to when it falls below it. The floor follows the size of the monthly payment and the age of the contract in whole months from the contract date to the assessment date.

| Monthly payment | Contract age at assessment | Late-fee floor |
|---|---|---|
| below the small-payment limit of 600.00 | at least 12 whole months | seasoned small-payment late-fee floor: 10.00 |
| below the small-payment limit of 600.00 | less than 12 whole months | new small-payment late-fee floor: 12.50 |
| 600.00 or more | any | the tier's minimum late fee |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Monthly payment | Contract date | Assessment date | Whole months | Floor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 599.99 | 2025-09-10 | 2026-09-10 | 12 | 10.00 |
| 599.99 | 2025-09-10 | 2026-09-09 | 11 | 12.50 |
| 600.00 | 2025-09-10 | 2026-09-10 | 12 | the tier's minimum late fee |

## Note to the schedule

A rounded late fee of 9.00 on a 360.00 payment, on a contract 20 whole months old, is raised to 10.00; the same 9.00 on a contract 5 whole months old is raised to 12.50. A rounded late fee of 13.00 on a contract 20 whole months old with a 360.00 payment is above the 10.00 floor and stays 13.00.
